description: common/mod.rs submission_matches_condition (lines 1947-1965): for each of identity_ids, email_ids, and thread_ids the function allocates a fresh HashSet<&Id> from the condition's Vec on every call. In a query loop over N submissions with a filter that specifies all three fields, this is 3N HashSet allocations. The same issue was caught for inMailboxOtherThan in email_matches_condition (JMAP-bx3z.4) but this function is not covered by that fix. Suggested rewrite: either pre-build the three sets before the per-submission loop (same pattern as top_level_excluded_set in query_objects), or add a SubmissionQueryContext struct that holds the pre-built sets and is passed into the condition check.
title: submission_matches_condition rebuilds HashSet per call for identity/email/thread ids
